entries.title: Brotato
entries.definitive_edition: Brotato on Windows PC with Abyssal Terrors DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Abyssal Terrors DLC and latest updates
primary.why: The Windows PC version has the original full release, Abyssal Terrors DLC, local co-op update, and the fastest ongoing update path. Console and mobile ports are valid, but PC is the most complete and highest-fidelity archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Brotato on Steam or Epic Games Store for Windows PC and add the Abyssal Terrors DLC for the current complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is an enhanced platform route, not a sequel or remaster. Mobile versions include different free/premium access models, so they are not the archive-primary route.
